gaps.sentence: The stairs ___ (reinforce) when part of the ceiling gave way.
gaps.hint: action in progress at a past moment
gaps.explanation: Past continuous passive: was/were being + past participle, interrupted by a sudden past event.

gaps.sentence: The castle ___ (restore) at present, so the east wing is closed to visitors.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + restored for work in progress now.

gaps.sentence: He refuses ___ (tell) what to do by people he's never met.
gaps.explanation: 'Refuse' takes a to-infinitive; passive meaning needs to be + told.

gaps.sentence: The parcels ___ (deliver) every morning before the shop opens.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive (am/is/are + past participle) for regular, repeated actions: are delivered.

gaps.sentence: Your contract will ___ for a further twelve months.
gaps.explanation: After 'will', passive = be + past participle: will be renewed.

gaps.sentence: The whole street ___ when the gas main burst.
gaps.explanation: The street was evacuated by others: past necessity had to be + evacuated.

gaps.sentence: By next June, the entire collection ___ (move) to the new wing.
gaps.explanation: Future perfect passive: will have been + past participle for something finished by 'next June'.

gaps.sentence: The Eiffel Tower ___ (design) by Gustave Eiffel's engineering firm.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive with agent: was designed by. Historical events take past simple.
